input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
input.rationale: Article XII is a one-way indemnity running from Licensee to Licensor, and it is drafted very broadly (Licensee's exercise of the license, conduct of its business, any breach). There is no Licensor indemnity anywhere in the Agreement, and Article XIII(a) goes further by excluding all Licensor liability for claims that use of the Licensed Technology infringes third-party IP, while Article XIII(b) caps Licensor liability at one half of fees paid. That is the playbook walk-away position: no Vendor IP indemnity plus a one-way Customer indemnity. The redline inserts a Licensor defence and indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, disapplies the Article XIII limitations to that indemnity (otherwise it is illusory), and narrows our indemnity to Licensee-provided content and our own breach of applicable law.

proposal.summary: Add a Licensor indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) and narrow the Licensee indemnity to Licensee-provided content and Licensee's breach of law.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XII currently runs one way only, and Article XIII expressly disclaims any Licensor liability for infringement claims, so we would carry the entire risk of the Licensed Technology infringing third-party IP. We have added a reciprocal Licensor indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct/gross negligence with standard notice-and-control procedure, and narrowed our indemnity to Licensee-provided content and our own breach of law. If helpful, we can accept the usual infringement exclusions (our modifications, combinations or specifications) plus procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees cap on Licensor's indemnity.

ops.text: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement (including Articles XII and XIII), Licensor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Licensee and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Licensed Technology, API's, Documentation or any other deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data caused by Licensor; or (d) Licensor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing liability or admitting fault on the indemnified party may be made without its consent), and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense. The limitations and exclusions of liability in Article XIII shall not apply to Licensor's obligations under this Article XII.
